name: gizza-ai/xpath-query
summary: Evaluate an XPath 1.0 expression against XML or XHTML

tool.description: Evaluate an XPath 1.0 expression against an XML or XHTML document and return matching nodes or values. Supports XPath 1.0 location paths, attributes, predicates, functions, scalar results, and node-set output as string values or serialized XML.

xml.description: The XML or XHTML document to query.

output.description: What to return for each matched node: value = its string value; xml = serialized outer XML.
